name: Delavirdine Mesylate

examples.title: Quality of Life of HIV-infected Participants Switched to Raltegravir Versus Other Antiretroviral Regimens (MK-0518-266)
examples.why: The trial was terminated early due to slow recruitment.

summary: According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, Delavirdine Mesylate received a high risk score of 76 for the liver and a low risk score of 25 for the heart [M]. There are three clinical study records found for this drug [3]. One of these trials was stopped early because it was enrolling participants too slowly [4].
